title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PublishPress…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in PublishPress Authors up to version 4.17.0. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of another user. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
